Agent Name: Planner

, Reason for Mistake: In Step 14, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandmother of Princess Augusta was "Christiane Henriette of Palatine Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld". This conclusion was based on a hallucination or misinterpretation of the previous search results. The search results explicitly identified Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen (1768–1849) as the mother of George II (the father of Princess Augusta), making her the paternal grandmother. The Planner seemingly confused the paternal grandmother (mother of the father) with the paternal grandfather's mother (mother of George I), or simply misread the available data. This error directly led to the wrong final answer provided in the conversation history.
